card.name: "of" after proportions, and opioid diversion phrase
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after a percentage, fraction or "majority" before a group of people or cases. Also "are" or "subject" inside the stock sentence "Opioids are sought for nonmedical use and are subject to diversion".

modes.label: Proportion then "of"
modes.description: "of" after a percent, fraction, "majority" or "analysis", leading into a population.
modes.example: it’s estimated at 15%<< of>> healthy people have spina bifida occ

modes.label: Opioid diversion sentence
modes.description: "are" or "subject" in the fixed label sentence about opioids being sought for nonmedical use.
modes.example: Opioids are sought for nonmedical use and<< are>> subject to diversion from legitimate prescribed use.

card.plain: It fires on the small word "of" after a share like 15% or "majority", and inside one repeated opioid label sentence.
